---
title: "Data & code"
---

Every figure on Fianaise is built from public data by code in the [fianaise.ie repository](https://github.com/fianaise/fianaise.ie). The data belongs to its publishers and keeps their licences.

| Dataset | Publisher | Used for | Pulled |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Marriages by form of ceremony (VSA44)](https://data.cso.ie/table/VSA44) | Central Statistics Office | [Marriages](religion/census-marriages.qmd) | 2000 to 2024 |
| [Religion by age group (F5071)](https://data.cso.ie/table/F5071) | Central Statistics Office | [Census affiliation](religion/census-marriages.qmd) | Census 2011, 2016, 2022 |
| [Primary School Survey 2025–2026](https://www.gov.ie/en/department-of-education/campaigns/primary-school-survey/) and [results summary report](https://assets.gov.ie/static/documents/1e08f77c/Primary_School_Survey_Results_Summary_Report_final__.pdf) | Department of Education and Youth | [Primary School Survey 2026](religion/primary-school-survey.qmd) | June 2026 |
| [Public Register of Charitable Organisations](https://www.charitiesregulator.ie/en/information-for-the-public/search-the-register-of-charities) | Charities Regulator | [The charities landscape](religion/charities.qmd) | Register of 26 October 2026 |
| [Data on individual schools](https://www.gov.ie/en/department-of-education/collections/data-on-individual-schools/) | Department of Education | [Patronage maps and figures](religion/schools.qmd), [survey school map](religion/primary-school-survey.qmd) and [the charities landscape](religion/charities.qmd) | 2025–26 school year (Schools page); 2024–25 for the survey map |
| [Family units in private households (F3035)](https://data.cso.ie/table/F3035) | Central Statistics Office | [Marriage in Ireland](marriage/index.qmd) | Census 2016, 2022 |
| Tax rates, bands, credits and CAT thresholds ([Revenue](https://www.revenue.ie/en/gains-gifts-and-inheritance/cat-thresholds-rates-and-aggregation-rules/cat-thresholds.aspx), [Citizens Information, Budget 2027](https://www.citizensinformation.ie/en/money-and-tax/budgets/budget-2027/)) | Revenue; Department of Finance | [The cost of not marrying](marriage/cost.qmd) and [calculator](marriage/calculator.qmd) | Budget 2027 (tax year 2027) |

## Code

- [`analysis/education_equality`](https://github.com/fianaise/fianaise.ie/tree/main/analysis/education_equality): fetches the CSO and Department of Education data and draws the religion and survey figures.
- [`analysis/charts`](https://github.com/fianaise/fianaise.ie/tree/main/analysis/charts): draws the census, marriage and survey charts and maps in the site's style. [`tools/fetch_school_lists.py`](https://github.com/fianaise/fianaise.ie/blob/main/tools/fetch_school_lists.py) downloads new school lists from gov.ie, and a GitHub Action redraws the maps whenever a new list is added.
- [`marriage/tax-rules.js`](https://github.com/fianaise/fianaise.ie/blob/main/marriage/tax-rules.js) and [`analysis/marriage`](https://github.com/fianaise/fianaise.ie/tree/main/analysis/marriage): the tax rules behind the Marriage in Ireland calculator and worked examples.
- [`analysis/charities`](https://github.com/fianaise/fianaise.ie/tree/main/analysis/charities): builds the charities landscape from the Charities Regulator's register.
